title: R code for the main figures of: Should CDR Be Phased Out After 2100? Investigating the Long-term Sustainability of Carbon Dioxide Removal
description: R code and figure data that draw Figs. 2 to 5 of the study. The scripts run after download without editing paths; see README.md. The full model results are in the companion dataset (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24074815).
